title: Unlock Necromancy and reach level 20
description: Complete the 'Necromancy!' quest to access the Necromancy skill and train to level 20 to unlock basic conjures.
exactAction: Travel to the City of Um via the portal in Edgeville, then speak to Death to start 'Necromancy!' quest

title: Reach level 99 Woodcutting
description: Train Woodcutting to 99 for the Lumberjack cape and efficient log collection.
exactAction: Cut Yew logs at Edgeville or Falador until level 85, then switch to Magic trees

title: Make 1M GP via Grand Exchange flipping
description: Learn basic GE flipping to fund further training.
prerequisites: Any level — just need starting GP
exactAction: Open Grand Exchange, search for high-volume items like Battlestaves, buy low/sell high within 5% margin
rewards: Foundation for expensive skills like Herblore and Invention
